rules.accepted_credit_types: Live courses, online courses, college courses beyond degree requirements (1 semester credit = 15, 1 quarter credit = 10 contact hours), written courses, conferences, and Level II or doctoral experiential student supervision (1 per week, max 12 per two-year period). Courses not sponsored by NBCOT, AOTA or WYOTA need a written course description on the CE log. No pre-approval.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed in an even-numbered year before July 31: no CE evidence that year; licensed in an odd-numbered year: 12 hours at the first even-year report.
rules.audit_note: CE hours are reported with the renewal in even-numbered years. Every even year 10% of licensees are randomly audited (notified by May 15); late renewals in even years must submit CE proof.
rules.legal_basis: Wyoming Board of Occupational Therapy Rules, Chapter 8, Sections 2–3; W.S. 33-40
rules.notes: Licenses renew annually (expire July 31; applications due by June 15 to avoid a late fee), but CE of 24 hours per two years is reported in even-numbered years; hours must be earned within the 3 years before the renewal. 1 contact hour = 1 hour. The 2023 rule lowered CE from 32 to 24 hours per two years.
